_note: GOLD-STANDARD TEMPLATE for the owner sign-off ledger consumed by pipeline/scripts/ffe_signoff_gate.py (and honoured by sourceability_gate). Place a real one as `sourcing-signoff.json` beside a project's 03_layout/ffe-candidates.json. It records that a TRAINED human confirmed each sourced pick's LIVE SKU + price (the DR's owner-signed law: sourcing is candidate-generation + owner signature, never auto-pick). A ledger sign flips a verified:false pick to effective-verified WITHOUT editing the ffe JSON, and STICKS across a re-research (it is keyed to the durable canonical key, not the ffe row). Run `python pipeline/scripts/ffe_signoff_gate.py <ffe-candidates.json> --keys` to print each sourceable pick's canonical key, then copy it here.

_how_to_sign.retailer-SKU pick (IKEA article / Index: add {sku, by, date} — the sku is matched globally-unique and dot/case/source-tolerant, so '003.540.63' or '00354063' and source 'IKEA' or 'IKEA Thailand' all bind. price_thb is recommended (freshness re-validates it) but not required.
_how_to_sign.SKU-less / made-to-order pick (composite: run --keys, copy the printed composite key verbatim into `key`, add {by, date}.
_how_to_sign.a VALID sign requires: a real `by` (NOT the OWNER-CONFIRM-PENDING template) + a `date` + an id anchor (`sku`/`article`/`key`). Missing the anchor or date => the gate surfaces it as MALFORMED (never silently dropped).
_how_to_sign.correcting a sign: APPEND a new entry for the same key — last usable entry wins; a trailing typo never erases an earlier valid sign.

signed.note: confirmed live at IKEA TH product page; dotted article — binds the undotted URL form too
retailer SKU pick — `key` copied from --keys; could equivalently be {sku: 110047607}
SKU-less made-to-order pick — the composite `key` copied verbatim from --keys
an unsigned template row is machine-INERT (never binds) — fill in by/date/sku to activate
